description:
Luizza – A Signature of Exclusivity

Luizza is a brand that redefines sophistication through exclusive, handcrafted leather belts. Designed for those who appreciate timeless elegance and artisanal craftsmanship, each piece is a statement of refined taste and individuality. Limited in production, Luizza belts are not just accessories—they are a signature of exclusivity, designed for those who understand that true luxury is about distinction, not mass production.  

 
Luizza belts are meticulously handcrafted using premium, sustainably sourced leather. Each design blends classic elegance with a modern edge, ensuring versatility for both casual and formal wear. From the selection of the finest materials to the precision in stitching and finishing, every detail is crafted to perfection. The belts feature high-quality hardware, a buttery-soft feel, and an impeccable fit, making them the ultimate investment piece for any wardrobe.  

  • Exclusive & Limited Production– Each belt is part of a limited collection, ensuring uniqueness and avoiding mass-market saturation.  
  • Handcrafted Excellence – Every piece is made with precision by skilled artisans, guaranteeing exceptional quality.  
  • Sustainable Elegance – Ethically sourced materials and responsible production methods align with modern values of sustainability.  
  • Timeless Appeal – Designed to elevate any outfit, from classic to contemporary styles, making them a staple for years to come.  

Affiliate Program – Payment Terms & Policies  
Luizza’s Affiliate Program offers competitive payouts with transparency and structure:  

Commission: Affiliates earn 15% on each sale made through their referral link.  
Payout Schedule: Payments are issued on the 20th of every month and also upon reaching 10 sales or $300, whichever comes first.  
- Payment Method: Payouts are made via direct bank transfer.  

Refunds & Chargebacks Policy  
To ensure fairness to both affiliates and Luizza, the following policies apply:  

- Refunds: If a customer requests a refund, the commission for that sale will be deducted from the affiliate’s earnings for the corresponding month.  
- Chargebacks: If a chargeback occurs, the commission for that sale will be reversed and subtracted from the affiliate's next payout.  
- No Commissions for Fraudulent Transactions: Sales deemed fraudulent, including chargebacks, refunds, or suspicious activity, will not qualify for commissions.  
- Payment Threshold: Affiliates are eligible for payment once their earnings reach a minimum of $50 (or your preferred threshold). Unpaid commissions will roll over to the next month until the threshold is met.  

Additional Information 
- Worldwide Shipping – Fast, reliable delivery with tracking.  
- Exclusivity Guarantee – Each belt is made in limited quantities and will not be restocked once sold out.  
- Custom Sizing Available – Special requests can be accommodated for a tailored fit.  
- Care Instructions – Each belt comes with a premium storage pouch and a detailed care guide to ensure longevity.
